info.title: DabApp Marketplace Admin API
info.description: Back-office API for the marketplace (catalog, vendors, orders, payouts, moderation). Every route needs an admin Bearer token (middleware auth.admin) and role_id = 1.

get.description: Active and inactive brands. per_page empty = everything, no pagination.

post.description: To add a logo, call POST /api/marketplace/upload-image (type=brand) first and send the URL it returns as logo_path.

put.description: Send only the fields to change. Send logo_path: null to remove the logo, or omit it to leave it untouched.

logo_path.description: URL from POST /api/marketplace/upload-image, or null to remove it

delete.description: Soft delete. Products of this brand stay, with no brand shown (deactivate the brand instead if you only want to hide it from filters).

get.description: Flat list, active and inactive. Filter by parent (parent_id=root for top-level). per_page empty = everything, no pagination.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Parent id, or the word root for top-level categories

post.description: slug is generated from the name when omitted. order_position defaults to the end of its siblings. To add an image, call POST /api/marketplace/upload-image (type=category) first and send the URL it returns as image_path.

put.description: Send only the fields to change. Send image_path: null to remove the image, or omit it to leave it untouched. A category cannot be moved under itself or one of its descendants.

image_path.description: URL from POST /api/marketplace/upload-image, or null to remove it

delete.description: Soft delete. Refused with 409 while the category has sub-categories (HAS_CHILDREN) or products (HAS_PRODUCTS).

post.description: Sets order_position for the given ids (same pattern as guide-categories/reorder).

put.description: Send only the fields to change. Deactivating a provider hides it from the vendor picker but keeps existing vendor methods.

delete.description: Soft delete. Refused with 409 (IN_USE) while vendors still have a shipping method on it: deactivate it instead.

get.description: All statuses. The IBAN is never in the list (open the detail). per_page empty = everything, no pagination.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: shop name, slug, or owner name / email / phone

post.description: A user can own one shop. status defaults to pending; creating it as active stamps approved_at / approved_by. slug is generated from shop_name when omitted. city_id must belong to country_id. For logo / cover_image, call POST /api/marketplace/upload-image (type=vendor) first and send the URLs it returns.

is_featured.description: Shown on the Marketplace home Shops row and the Featured badge on All Shops

get.description: Totals per status, for the tabs of the vendors screen.
Full record including bank name, IBAN and commission override.

put.description: Send only the fields to change. Send logo_path / cover_image_path: null to remove that image, or omit it to leave it untouched. Status changes go through approve / suspend / reject, not this endpoint. Empty commission_override clears the override.

user_id.description: Transfer the shop to another account

logo_path.description: URL from POST /api/marketplace/upload-image, or null to remove it

cover_image_path.description: URL from POST /api/marketplace/upload-image, or null to remove it

delete.description: Soft delete. Refused with 409 HAS_ORDERS once the shop has sold something (suspend it instead). Its products leave the storefront.

post.description: pending, rejected or suspended becomes active (reactivation). 409 INVALID_STATE if already active. Stamps approved_at / approved_by and clears the reason. Its active products become visible in the storefront.
active becomes suspended: the shop and all its products disappear from the storefront (orders already placed are not touched). A reason is required. 409 INVALID_STATE if not active.
pending becomes rejected. A reason is required. 409 INVALID_STATE if not pending.

post.summary: Add a shipping method to a vendor
post.description: A vendor can have a given provider only once. The provider must be active. uses_own_api=true requires credentials (key/value object, e.g. {api_key, account_number}); they are stored encrypted and never returned. Without an own API the flat_rate is used, no carrier call is made (v1).

put.description: Send only the fields to change. credentials replaces the stored keys when sent; clear_credentials=true removes them. Turning uses_own_api off also wipes the keys. The provider cannot be changed (delete and add another).

delete.description: Soft delete. Orders already placed keep their shipping snapshot.

id.description:
Swagger root for the marketplace Admin Panel documentation.
UI: /marketplace-admin/documentation

is_featured.description: Curated by an admin: shown on the Marketplace home Shops row and the Featured badge on All Shops

iban.description: Detail only. The list never returns it.

has_credentials.description: Keys are write-only: only this flag is ever returned

message.example: Category has products and cannot be deleted

tags.name: Admin Marketplace - Brands
tags.description: Product brands. logo_path is a URL from POST /api/marketplace/upload-image (type=brand), not a file: upload first, then send the string here.

tags.name: Admin Marketplace - Categories
tags.description: Category tree management (unlimited depth). image_path is a URL from POST /api/marketplace/upload-image (type=category), not a file: upload first, then send the string here.

tags.name: Admin Marketplace - Shipping providers
tags.description: Global list of carriers (DHL, Aramex, SMSA, DabApp Shipping, Manual). Vendors pick from this list.

tags.name: Admin Marketplace - Vendors
tags.description: Shops: creation, branding (logo, cover, brand color), approval workflow, commission override. logo_path / cover_image_path are URLs from POST /api/marketplace/upload-image (type=vendor), not files: upload first, then send the strings here.

tags.name: Admin Marketplace - Vendor shipping methods
tags.description: What a vendor actually offers: one or more carriers from the global providers list, each with a flat rate. Carrier API keys are write-only, encrypted at rest and never returned (only has_credentials).
